description: T-4585: how Excel names a pivot cache's fields when the source header repeats a name, has a blank cell or differs only in case. D!A1:F1 is Region, Sales, then formulas the case builder cannot see through: ="Sales" (a second Sales), ="" (a blank header), ="region" (Region in another case) and ="Sales"&"" (a third Sales). The builder caches those formula headers under their formula text, so Excel's refresh on open (refreshOnLoad) renames them; the sidecar's `pivots` cache_fields hold the names Excel saves. N1 is rows Region, Sum of Sales. Q!A1 makes the case scored.
